about: Minimal repairs applied to copies of the pristine upstream SFL+ sources so the PlayStation_core hierarchy translates. Upstream files in the repo root are never modified. Each fix pins the upstream SHA-256; a changed upstream file must be re-reviewed. In 'old'/'new', \n stands for the file's own line ending (CRLF for every upstream .sflp). See docs/POCKET_CORE_TRANSLATION.md.

fixes.reason: output file_adrs<32> is declared twice in one interface (lines 114 and 116, identical). Drop the second copy.
fixes.evidence: d2bf610 (2025-05-15) added the second declaration; both are byte-identical.

fixes.reason: Line 757 'else : read_io_wait.do();' names a stage task without generate; it is the only such statement in all sources. The two sibling branches (747, 755) use 'generate read_io_wait.do();', and only that stage acknowledges this CPU read, so a no-op would leave the CPU waiting. Interpreted as generate.
fixes.evidence: Present since 93fbb63 (2021, PSX_core rename); rg over all *.sflp finds no other bare stage-task call. The native meaning of the bare form is not recorded locally.
fixes.new: else : generate read_io_wait.do(); // Q-L1-11 F7: 'generate' missing upstream

fixes.reason: cache_hit_reg is assigned once (line 195, column 0) and never declared or read anywhere. Comment the stray write out; no width is invented.
fixes.evidence: Introduced by 32e1b76 (2025-11-30); the only reference in all sources.

fixes.reason: dbg32 = dbg32_reg; is left over after 3fa770f renamed DMA_CDR's dbg32/dbg32_reg to dbg/dbg_reg. PlayStation_core reads cdr.dbg32 from CDROM_controller, not from DMA_CDR.
fixes.evidence: 3fa770f diff: -output dbg32<32>; -reg_wr dbg32_reg<32>; +output dbg<32>; +reg_wr dbg_reg<32>. PlayStation_core.sflp:113 'CDROM_controller cdr;', :173 'dbg32 = cdr.dbg32'.
fixes.new: //dbg32 = dbg32_reg; // Q-L1-11 F3: stale after rename to dbg/dbg_reg

fixes.reason: under640 is assigned (line 85) and read (line 112) at circuit scope but never declared. Declare it as a one-bit sel, exactly as drawPoly.sflp:321 does; the assigned expression is a single bit select <10>.
fixes.evidence: Added by d699e96 (2025-10-22) together with its use; drawPoly.sflp:321 'sel under640;' and :324 the same assignment.
fixes.new:
sel under640; // Q-L1-11 F4: declaration missing upstream (as drawPoly)
	under640 = (vx1-0b01010000000)<10>; // x < 640

fixes.reason: GPU forwards texture_full to poly.texture_full(), but no published drawPoly.sflp has a texture_full terminal. Make GPU's texture_full a no-op; drawPoly behaves as published. The author's unpublished texture_full mode is therefore absent.
fixes.evidence: 5f4ab66 (2023-01-11) added the forwarding; texture_full/texture_thin never appear in drawPoly.sflp at 5f4ab66, 10244b8, a216a99, d699e96 or 8467f78. PlayStation_core.sflp:561 calls gpu.texture_full() every cycle.
fixes.new: //	instruct texture_full if(^dispW) poly.texture_full(); // Q-L1-11 F5: port absent in published drawPoly

fixes.reason: dma_size = size_mul.con(bcr<31:16>, bcr<15:0>).dout<30:0> || 0b0 (BA*BS*2 halfwords) still uses the mul_u16 instance and a 32-bit bcr that 3fa770f removed/narrowed. Restore the three declarations from 3fa770f^ (declare mul_u16 interface, mul_u16 size_mul, 32-bit bcr; reset style 'reg' kept) and supply mul_u16.v from 2526d25^.
fixes.evidence: 3fa770f diff: -declare mul_u16 interface{...}; -mul_u16 size_mul; -reg_wr bcr<32>; +reg bcr<16>. 2526d25 (same day) deleted mul_u16.v; Pocket/source_fixes/mul_u16.v is that file byte-for-byte (git show 2526d25^:mul_u16.v).

fixes.reason: Second half of F6: 32-bit bcr and the size_mul instance.
fixes.new:
reg bcr<32>; // Q-L1-11 F6: 16 upstream, but bcr<31:16> is read
	mul_u16 size_mul; // Q-L1-11 F6
